content_metadata.description: A tutorial video by JimmyKnives on fixing alert box issues in Stream Elements and setting it up in OBS.

qAndA.answer: The 'amount of zero' setting under Tip, Host, and Cheer alerts was mistakenly set to a higher value, preventing alerts for smaller amounts from appearing.
qAndA.question: What specific setting caused the alert box to malfunction?

qAndA.answer: JimmyKnives sets the resolution to 1920x1080 to ensure the alert box fills the entire screen.
qAndA.question: What is the recommended resolution for the alert box in OBS?

qAndA.answer: Stream Elements conducted a live test by sending a test follower event to JimmyKnives' channel, confirming the alert box was functioning correctly.
qAndA.question: How did Stream Elements help JimmyKnives verify the solution?

qAndA.answer: The video maintains a neutral and informative tone throughout, focusing on providing a clear solution to a technical problem.
qAndA.question: What is the overall mood of the video?

qAndA.answer: The sound is a short clip of electronic dance music. The song is titled 'The Cool Guy Club' and is published by the YouTube channel 'NCS'.
qAndA.question: Can you describe the sound played when the follower event notification is triggered?

activities.description: JimmyKnives introduces himself and the topic of the video.
He explains the problem he faced with his alert box.
He briefly demonstrates the testing feature of the alert box on Stream Elements.
He describes the issue encountered while using the alert box during a live stream.
He reiterates the video's purpose and encourages viewers to like, subscribe, and follow him on Twitch.

A second computer screen showing a preview of the Stream Elements alert box.

scenes.thematicElements: Technical troubleshooting, Stream Elements, alert box setup
scenes.title: Introduction

activities.description: JimmyKnives navigates to Stream Elements and instructs viewers to ensure they are signed in and their channel is joined.
He proceeds to 'My Overlays' and opens his alert box for editing.
He walks through various alert settings, including follower alert, subscriber alert, tip alert, host alert, and cheer alert, highlighting specific settings that might cause issues.
He emphasizes the 'amount of zero' setting in tips, host alerts, and cheers, which displays all alerts.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Provides detailed instructions on configuring Stream Elements settings to fix alert box issues.

narrativeProgression.description: Step-by-step demonstration of navigating and configuring Stream Elements settings.

props.name: Computer screen displaying the Stream Elements dashboard.
The 'My Overlays' page on Stream Elements.
The alert box editing interface, showcasing various alert settings.

scenes.thematicElements: Technical walkthrough, alert box configuration, troubleshooting
scenes.title: Stream Elements Setup

activities.description: JimmyKnives switches to OBS and disables the preview temporarily.
He adds a new 'browser source' and names it 'alert test.'
He pastes the copied overlay URL from Stream Elements and sets the source size to 1920x1080.
He re-enables the preview, revealing multiple stacked screens.
He highlights the red square representing the alert box and demonstrates its functionality by sending test follower events.
He resizes and repositions the alert box.
He explains that Stream Elements did a live test with him, and it worked.
He offers to conduct a live test with viewers.
He concludes the tutorial and encourages viewers to like, subscribe, and follow him on Twitch.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Demonstrates the practical application and testing of the alert box setup in OBS.

Reinforcement of the solution's validity through a past successful live test.
